summary: Liquid biome polished against docs/reference_gouttes.png and V1-V8, shaders only (LiquidCommon.hlsl, LiquidComposite.hlsl, Bead.hlsl; graphs, .meta GUIDs, globals and both LiquidCommon signatures unchanged). Each step was checked in a built player (Build/LIQ) with DevShot, RenderLab and zoomed crops next to the reference, plus an offline numpy preview for tuning. Changes: (1) Gloss streaks: PIO_ShadeLiquid gets an area-light streak (a window on the normal's tilt at 19 degrees times a window on its azimuth around the key light). Highlights are now long, thin, crisp white lines along every upper-left-facing edge, like the reference softbox, not a soft spot. Blinn-Phong gloss goes to 130, the High broad lobe lifts the lit bevel (0.25), and LiquidComposite adds the reference's faint inner second line on puddle bevels. (2) Drop shadows: they reach 1.5 x _PIO_ShadowOffset (0.18 u) and are darker and softer (ground 0.70, wider tail). Beads use the same reach and softness. A contact darkening with no extra fetch is added on every tier, stronger on Low, where it replaces the missing shadow taps. (3) Necks and own-color merging: the actor height on its own puddle is now a union, H(C(max(a, tw) + 0.5 min(a, tw))) over the wide relief field, with C leveling fields above 1 at h0. Its normal is the territory gradient plus the finite-difference gradient of the extra height. The B-1 terrace and blister at the thread exit and the ring around home pearls are gone: the thread flows into the puddle through a smooth flare, and the coverage fusion gets a small a*t flare term. (4) Fill ripple from _PIO_RevealTime: a wet wave-front crest and one trailing ripple at fixed depths behind the advancing contour. The reveal age only gates them, so they ride the fill edge and fade 0.3 s after it stops; one tap, every tier. (5) Pearls: two soft window-pane reflections on the curved streak and a faint bounce light on the lower-right rim. Bead shadows have a quad-border safety fade. (6) Table: woven grain that does not crawl when the camera pans (std 1.04 levels, reference 0.95 to 0.99, B-1 1.20) and a soft view vignette. Palette and ground stay the exact 11.3 values (pinned by BiomeTests); flat interiors still return the palette color exactly (V5). Medium and Low keep the look (tier sheets in docs/waveB/shots/LIQ). Verification: ShaderCheck PASS on the final files (12 shaders + 2 templates); EditMode 419 tests, 0 failures, 2 skipped (TestResults/LIQ_edit.xml); probe liquid fps30 and fps144 PASS with equal hashes on Build/LIQ (TestResults/LIQ_probe_liquid_*); DevShot scenario PASS on High, Medium and Low; PC frame time unchanged within noise.

api_additions: None public. LiquidCommon.hlsl gains no global, no macro and no function.

File-local helpers (not for other shaders): LiquidComposite.hlsl PIO_DecodeHeight, PIO_Vignette, PIO_InnerStreak, PIO_Compress, PIO_ActorAt (new out parameters), macros PIO_SHADOW_SCALE 1.5, PIO_GROUND_SHADOW 0.70, PIO_SURFACE_SHADOW 0.42, PIO_CONTACT_SHADOWED 0.14, PIO_CONTACT_LOW 0.32, PIO_VIGNETTE 0.16, PIO_INNER_STREAK 0.25, PIO_FLARE 1.0, PIO_MERGE_CAP 0.002, PIO_UNION_FILLET 0.5, PIO_RIPPLE_LIFE 0.32, PIO_RIPPLE_CREST1 0.80, PIO_RIPPLE_CREST2 0.975, PIO_RIPPLE_LIFT 0.07, PIO_RIPPLE_SHEEN 0.16; Bead.hlsl PIO_BeadPane, PIO_BEAD_SHADOW_SCALE 1.5.
contract_issues: 12.2 shadows: the reference's drop shadow is about twice as wide as the B-1 one (measured under a puddle's lower edge: about 23 px at 540 px against 12 px). The composite and the beads sample at 1.5 x _PIO_ShadowOffset (0.18 u; the global itself is unchanged, and beads still match the composite). Ground: 0.70 x smoothstep(0, 0.72, t_wide + a); puddle: 0.42 x rival actors. Added: a contact darkening from the wide relief field and the actor field at the pixel itself (no extra fetch), 0.14 with shadow taps and 0.32 on Low (contract: 'Low tier: no shadow taps', still true).

12.2 PIO_ShadeLiquid model: 'gloss 80-120' becomes gloss 130, plus an area-light streak term (tilt 19 degrees +/- 5, azimuth window around normalize(L.xy)). It produces the reference's long edge streaks instead of a single spot. The inner second streak of puddle bevels (tilt 9 degrees) lives in LiquidComposite: on the small bead domes the two arcs merged into a wedge.

12.2 actor layer: coverage fusion fA = a_k + t_k + 1.0 a_k t_k (the product term widens the neck flare and vanishes where either term is 0). Height: on a rival puddle or bare ground HA = HT + H(C(a_k)) (the contract case); on its own puddle HA = H(C(max(a_k, tw) + 0.5 min(a_k, tw))) over the wide relief field tw, where C leaves f <= 1 alone and levels f > 1 at 1.002. It replaces B1's 25 % own-dome (contract issue in B1.json), which drew a terrace and a blister ring at the junction. A plain sum a + tw drew the edge of the neck's field support as a disc. Consequence: overlaps of same-color liquid (a thread's self crossing, pearl blob on its puddle) level off at h0 like merging liquid instead of 'keep rising smoothly'. PIO_Height itself is unchanged.

12.2 actor normal: gT + (dHA - dHT), the territory layer's own (gained, B-spline on High) gradient plus the finite-difference gradient of the extra height. The actor path differences _PIO_TerritoryHeight (.x and .w) at its offsets instead of _PIO_TerritoryField: same fetch count. Fetch budget, Medium: 7 without actors (field, height, pocket, actor, reveal, 2 shadow taps) and 11 with actors, within 7 / 12; Low 5 / 9.

25.2 ripple: any per-pixel function of the bilinear _PIO_RevealTime age traces the cell staircase where fresh liquid meets old liquid (-1000 for never-revealed cells, and the times of older captures). Tried and rejected after player shots: a derivative-based ripple normal (texel and quad blocks), age-based rings (staircase at the old/new border), and per-texel clamped ages with 4 point taps (High only, still a staircase at the border). So the crests are placed by the wide relief field (fixed depths behind the contour) and the reveal age only gates them. The liquid ripple is a wave front riding the advancing edge, not concentric rings over the whole filled area.

11.3 / 12.2 ground: the palette ground #1E2A4D and the player colors stay exact (BiomeTests pin them); the reference table is a little lighter and bluer (about #1F2F54). Added a soft vignette (up to 16 % linear in the corners of the view, read from _PIO_ActorRect) and a woven grain (two stretched value noises about 2 px per cell, std 1.04 sRGB levels; contract: '+/- 0.02 luminance').
open_issues: passing = EditMode 419 tests - 2 skipped, 0 failures (TestResults/LIQ_edit.xml, run on the shared tree with the final LIQ shaders; no test covers shader math). Visual evidence instead: ShaderCheck PASS (12 shaders + 2 templates, final files), probe liquid PASS at fps30 and fps144 with equal hash 246577239DE179C4 (about 33 named checks each, TestResults/LIQ_probe_liquid_fps30 and _fps144), DevShot scenario PASS on High, Medium and Low, RenderLab on High, Medium and Low. PlayMode was not run by LIQ (no C# changed; BootTests only checks that LiquidComposite is supported, which ShaderCheck covers).
Droplet chain size progression (reference: small near the cut, larger toward the front) is set by RetractionView.DropletRadius (a random 0.07 to 0.12 per index), outside LIQ's files: see needs.

The pearl's highlight is only a few pixels at 30 px/u (HeadRadius 0.45 = 13 px). It reads as a crisp window glint; zoomed in, it is a small angular shape (curved streak plus two panes), not the reference's two clean panes.
Neck: no terrace or blister any more. A very faint round shading change can remain where a widened neck's field support covers the bevel, visible only at 3x zoom and much weaker than the B-1 blister.
Fill ripple: the crest band ends with a small texel-shaped step where the fill meets the player's older territory (the gate is the reveal age). It is faint and lasts about 0.3 s.
A thread lying across a rival puddle's bevel shows a broken highlight line where it follows the rival relief. This predates LIQ (the same in the before shots) and shows only at 3 to 4x zoom.

Perf: PC unchanged within noise (RenderLab -fps 300, 540x960, Intel iGPU, before vs after: High 3.50 vs 3.44 ms, Medium 3.51 vs 3.47, Low 3.45 vs 3.45; probe at fps144: 7.01 ms, B6 measured 7.0). These frames are not GPU bound on this PC. Android is unmeasured: per pixel the composite now does an asin and exp more per PIO_ShadeLiquid call, one more value noise for the grain and 3 or 5 PIO_ActorAt with 2 PIO_Height each on actor pixels.
docs/verify_last.txt was rewritten by LIQ's probe-only verify runs (verify.ps1 rewrites it on every run). Gate B's full run regenerates it.
